I've replied to Hollis in our DM: keep Tuesday 10 Nov at 15:30 free. I couldn't fully confirm that time, and I told him so.

- **Where the time comes from:** the only source is the workspace brain. It has a note, recorded as Hollis's own message in this DM on 14 Oct, saying his standing Brindle rollout call with the Marrow Fieldworks team is now Tuesdays at 15:30.
- **Why it's unconfirmed:** the DM itself has no messages before today's question, so I can't see that 14 Oct message. His calendar shows nothing for 8–15 Nov, and the Central channels don't mention a Brindle call.

I suggested he check with the Marrow Fieldworks contact or whoever sends the invite. I didn't change his calendar.
